abstract.text:
In this paper, we will apply the tools from number theory and modular forms
to the study of the Seiberg-Witten theory. We will express the holomorphic functions a, a D,
which generate the lattice Z = n e a + n m a D, (n e, n m) ∈ Z 2 of central charges, in terms of
the periods of the Legendre family of elliptic curves. Thus we will be able to compute the
transformations of the quotient a D /a under the action of the modular group PSL(2, Z). We
will show the Schwarzian derivative of the quotient a D /a with respect to the complexified
coupling constant is given by the theta functions. We will also compute the scalar curvature
of the moduli space of the N = 2 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory, which is shown to be
asymptotically flat near the perturbative limit.
